Welfare of Tribals
*301. SHRIMATI SARLA
 MAHESHWARI:
SHRI A. VIJAYA RAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of TRIBAL
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that grants for
the welfare of tribals were distributed to
NGOs which were virtually non-existent;
(b) if so, the methodology adopted to
scrutinize the legitimacy of these
organisations while granting funds;
(c) whether Government initiated any
action against the authority concerned for
such corrupt practices;
(d) if so, the details thereof; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
VRS in PSEs
*302. SHRIMATI VANGA GEETHA:
Will the Minister of HEAVY INDUSTRIES
AND PUBLIC ENTERPRISES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government are coming up
with another round of Voluntary Retirement
F:\WIN2\SESSION 80RS.PM5
Scheme for staff of Public Sector
Enterprises;
(b) the number of surplus staff in
different PSEs;
(c) the estimated amount to be paid to
separating employees; and
(d) the other details in this regard?
Unauthorised occupation of public
land
*303. SHRI ABANI ROY: Will the
Minister of URBAN DEVELOPMENT
AND POVER TY ALLEVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether some of the ground
floor allottees of Block No. 21, Lodhi
Colony, New Delhi have appropriated the
common open space among themselves
thus putting the first floor allottees to
disadvantage;
(b) whether some ground floor allottees
of aforesaid Block had unauthorisedly
occupied the public land beyond the wall;
and
(c) whether the C.P.W.D. have also
contributed unwittingly in this illegal act

by putting barbed wire-fencing on payment
basis?
Mandatory telecast of channels by
Cable networks
*304. SHRI YADLAPATI VENKAT
RAO: Will the Minister of
INFORMATION AND  BROAD-
CASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether DD Bharati Broadcasting
Corporation of India has made it mandatory
for cable networks to telecast three DD
channels on their network; and
(b) the States where DD Bharati will
have to be shown compulsorily by cable
operators?
Objections of CAG in BALCO
disinvestment
†*305. SHRI BALKAVI BAIRAGI:
Will the Minister of DISINVESTMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that CAG has
made serious objections in respect of
BALCO disinvestment deal in its interim
report;
(b) if so, whether CAG has made a
reference to the department for not assessing
the captive power plant at BALCO; and
(c) by when the CAG report would be
laid on the Table of the House?
Outbreak of plague in H.P. and
Haryana
*306. PROF. M. SANKARA-
LINGAM: Will the Minister of HEALTH
AND FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether a team of experts has been
deputed by his Ministry to investigate the
outbreak of plague in Himachal Pradesh and
Haryana;
(b) if so, whether the team has submitted
its Report;
(c) if so, the findings of the Report;
and
(d) the efforts made by his Ministry to
check the spread of plague in these States
and to other parts of the country?
Sale of profit making industries
†*307. SHRI JANESHWAR MISHRA:
Will the Minister of DISINVESTMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are considering to sell those industries to
the private institutions which are earning
profit and are the backbone of the economy
of the country, under pressure from foreign
investors;
(b) if so, the total number of such
companies which Government propose to
sell despite their earning profit  alongwith
details thereof;
(c) whether Government propose to sell
National Fertilizer Limited, which is earning
profit to the private sector; and
(d) if so, the reasons therefor?
Banning the RIL from bidding for
IPCL
*308. SHRI J. CHITHARANJAN:
SHRI V.V. RAGHAVAN:
Will the Minister of DISINVEST-
MENT be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are considering banning Reliance Industries

PHCs in Rajasthan
*309. SHRI SANTOSH BAGRODIA:
Will the Minister of HEALTH AND
FAMILY WELFARE be pleased to state:
(a) the details of Primary Health Centres
run by Government in the State of
Rajasthan;
(b) whether Government propose to
open more such centres in Rajasthan; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?

Public sector investments in NER
2213. DR. MANMOHAN SINGH:
Will the Minister of DEVELOPMENT OF
NORTH-EASTERN REGION be pleased
to state :
(a) the estimate of public sector
investments in the North-Eastern Region
from 1995-96 to 2000-2001, State-wise;
(b) the details of these investments,
sector-wise;
(c) the share of public sector investments
in the North-Eastern Region in total
estimated public sector investments in the
country as a whole; and
(d) the measures adopted by
Government to accelerate the tempo of public
sector investments in the North-Eastern
Region?
Involvement of the North-Eastern
Region with the national
mainstream
2214. SHRI NARENDRA MOHAN :
Will the Minister of DEVELOPMENT OF
NORTH-EASTERN REGION be pleased
to state :
(a) whether it is a fact that despite years
of developmental largesse from Government
aiming at mainstreaming the North-East,
feeling of oneness with the rest of country
has not significantly emerged amongst local
people of these areas; and
(b) if so, the steps being taken to further
involve them so that impediments to lasting
peace in the North-East are avoided
especially in view of the belligerent
neighbouring countries around the North-
East?
Preclusion of IOC from bidding in  oil
PSUs
2215. SHRI K.B. KRISHNA
MURTHY:
SHRI NILOTPAL BASU:
Will the Minister of DISINVESTMENT
be pleased to state :
(a) whether post-IBP acquisition, Indian
Oil Corporation has been precluded from
bidding for stakes in other oil PSUs like
HPCL and BPCL;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether this decision by Government
is based on the policy that the sale of one
PSU to another would not amount to
privatisation;

486
WIN2\SESSION\82RS 486
(d) the reasons for choosing IOC to bid
for IBP; and
(e) whether preclusion of IOC from
bidding for BPCL/HPCL stakes will lead
to cartelisation and manipulation of
valuation by other two bidders?
Creation of Disinvestment Fund
2216. SHRI MAN MOHAN SAMAL:
Will the Minister of DISINVESTMENT
be pleased to state :
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have failed to meet the divestment targets
for the Ninth Plan;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether Government have finalised
the creation of proposed Disinvestment
Fund; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Disinvestment of VSNL
2217. MISS MABEL REBELLO: Will
the Minister of DISINVESTMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have recently
disinvested VSNL to the Tata Group of
Industries at Rs. 202/- per share;
(b) whether this involves the cost of land
as well;
(c) if not, whether the original share-
holders should not be compensated for the
segregation of land by Government;
(d) if so, whether VSNL shares were
sold at very cheap prices; and
(e) whether VSNL would be able to earn
as much money as it was earning under the
public sector?
Strategic sale of BSNL
2218. SHRI NILOTPAL BASU: Will
the Minister of DISINVESTMENT be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have decided
to go for strategic sale of BSNL;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the privatisation of VSNL
and the fact that VSNL itself is having a
licence as a NLD operator has put the future
revenue earning potential of BSNL from
incoming international long distance
telephone traffic into jeopardy and thereby
will depress the valuation of BSNL;
(d) if so, whether Government will
recommend that BSNL be awarded ILD
licence forthwith; and
(e) if so, by when and if not, the reasons
therefor?
Disinvestment in oil companies
2219. SHRI CHO S. RAMASWAMY:
SHRI NANA DESHMUKH:
Will the Minister of DISINVESTMENT
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
are planning to disinvest the oil companies;
(b) the names of companies and
Government's plan in regard thereto and by
when it is likely to be taken up;
(c) the total stake which is likely to be
downloaded;
(d) whether it is also a fact that blue
chip/profit making units are also being
considered for such disinvestment; and
(e) if so, the reasons therefor?

(b) whether Bharat Wagon Engineering
Company Ltd. of Muzaffarpur and
Mokamah of Bihar are also kept in the list
of the heavy industries to be disinvested;
and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
